policy: Architecture reproduction in PyTorch, random initialization; no author pretrained weights. TRAIN-only fits, participant-separated VALIDATION for checkpoint and threshold. No TEST extraction, scoring, augmentation, model selection or refit in this run.
differences: Use architecture model.json: causal conv16/16/24/24 k9/7/5/5; pool4 then3; dropout after pools and Dense48; GlorotNormal except final GlorotUniform, rather than README's uniform description.
Author script loads model.h5, randomly splits overlapping windows, passes three copies to a one-input model and declares but does not pass EarlyStopping; these behaviors are not reproduced.
Use participant-separated validation and actually restore the validation-loss checkpoint with patience10/min_delta0.001; no random window validation.
Per-window gyro demeaning only; no bandpass or population standardization; degrees/s. Window labels retain project >=50% rule including exact ties, unlike pandas mode tie-to-zero in author script.
Window inside each record and contiguous finite gyro run, including last complete window; no interpolation. Only gyro is required, not missing accelerometer channels.
PyTorch AdamW weight_decay0.0004 uses learning-rate-scaled decay; tensorflow_addons AdamW has different decay semantics. This is architecture reproduction, not numerical or paper-score reproduction.
